capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Lucid 2025 Pure sheet capacity 84 kWh and EV Database 84.0 usable / 88.0 nominal (search excerpt) for the same pack family; Lucid markets 5.0 mi/kWh on 84 kWh. 2027 assumed unchanged.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Lucid battery data (MY26+ packs) gives chemistry ID "Li MM(NRMC) - C.F", read as nickel-rich NMC (the page does not decode it).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Lucid 2025 Pure sheet gives platform architecture 650V+ (above 600 V, the 800 V class); Evercars says 900V-class for every Air.

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: manual Start Preconditioning plus Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger). Current software state; the page is not year-specific.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2025 pack assumed for 2027 (Lucid battery data lists one Pure 16M pack for MY26+). Lucid 2025 Pure sheet: battery capacity 84 kWh (16 module); Lucid says 420 mi from 84 kWh.

dc_max_kw.notes: Evercars (2026 comparison) and the Wikipedia trim table: Pure peak 250 kW; no Lucid Pure sheet states DC kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid Canada charging page: AC charging maximum 19.2 kW; Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW (240 V, 80 A) for every trim.
